name: of1-demo-skills
description: Turn any website into an OF1 generative-search demo on Adobe Edge Delivery Services (prototype+deploy pipeline — block-based Stage 2 via stardust:deploy). Ships the orchestrator plus the demo-build skills (discovery, prototype, deploy) and a standalone skill that authors the of1/config/signals DA sheet. Depends on of1-skills for the actual OF1-integration step.

_notes.entrypoints: of1-demo-orchestrator is the single orchestrator (Claude Code only); it follows knowledge/dispatch-cc.md for Stage 1/2. Stage 3 (OF1 integration) is one inline call to of1-skills:of1-integration. of1-signals is a standalone skill, not a numbered pipeline step — it authors the of1/config/signals DA sheet (read by the preview extension and the edge proxy; must be previewed and published) that neither the sync/deploy pipeline nor the OF1 worker ever reads.
